name: get_project_summary
title: Get project summary
description: Read the current project name, aggregate health, total task count, and in-progress count from page-local state. Use this read-only capability only for project-level summaries. It does not return task records and must never be used to find, filter, resolve, or select tasks; use the advertised task lookup capability for every task question or task-based mutation.

output.description: The current project name, health, total task count, and number of in-progress tasks.

statusMessages.complete: The latest project health is ready.

name: search_tasks
title: Search tasks
description: Read and resolve task records already loaded in this page by the user's original title, owner, priority, status, or other task-description words. This is the required read-only capability for every task lookup, including task details, filters, and selecting tasks for an 'all' request. Return matching records with exact IDs; callers must complete this lookup before any mutation, use only exact returned IDs, and treat zero matches or multiple matches as a reason to clarify rather than guess. Do not use the project-summary capability for task discovery.

query.description: The original task description or search text from the user

output.description: An array of matching task records with their IDs, titles, owners, statuses, priorities, and due dates.

name: get_current_user
title: Get current user
description: Read the signed-in user and permissions from the local session state.

output.description: The signed-in user's profile, role, permissions, and local session source.

name: set_task_status
title: Set task status
description: Mutate only the status field of one task, identified by an exact task ID returned by the advertised task lookup capability, then return the updated task record. Use only after the user explicitly authorizes a status change and lookup has resolved exactly one task, except an explicit 'all' request may apply the requested status to every returned match. Accept only the advertised status values; this capability does not find tasks and never changes priority.

status.description: Status is case-insensitive; use "In progress" for active work.

output.description: The updated task record, or an error object when the status or task ID is invalid.

errorExamples.error: Invalid status. Use one of: Todo, In progress, Done

statusMessages.complete: The task status has been updated.

name: set_task_priority
title: Set task priority
description: Mutate only the priority field of one task, identified by an exact task ID returned by the advertised task lookup capability, then return the updated task record. Use only after the user explicitly authorizes a priority change and lookup has resolved exactly one task. Accept only the advertised priority values; this capability does not find tasks and never changes status.

priority.description: Priority is case-insensitive; use High, Medium, or Low.

output.description: The updated task record, or an error object when the priority or task ID is invalid.

errorExamples.error: Invalid priority. Use one of: High, Medium, Low

statusMessages.complete: The task priority has been updated.
